Container.Name: cups-label-crop
Container.Overview: CUPS print server with AirPrint and a "Label Crop" queue for online sellers. Print a Vinted, InPost, Evri (or other carrier) A4/Letter shipping sheet to "Label Crop" and it finds the shipping label on the page, crops it, turns it upright and sends a sharp 4x6 label to your thermal printer (Zebra, Rollo, Munbyn, SATO, Brother, DYMO... anything with a CUPS driver).[br][br]Setup: start the container, open the WebUI (login with CUPSADMIN/CUPSPASSWORD), add your label printer with the queue name you set in TARGET_PRINTER (default Label_Printer). Vendor drivers (.deb) dropped into /config/drivers are installed at every start. Host networking is required for AirPrint discovery.[br][br]Free software under GPL-3.0. Label detection is based on dodopus/vinted-label-4x6.
Container.Requires: Host networking (for AirPrint/mDNS). A label printer reachable over the network or USB, and its CUPS driver.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: CUPS settings, printers, PPDs and the drivers/ drop-in folder. Keep this so printers survive updates.

Config.Name: CUPS admin user
Config.Description: User name for the CUPS web UI (port 631) admin pages.

Config.Name: CUPS admin password
Config.Description: Password for the CUPS admin user. Required: pick your own.

Config.Name: Target printer queue
Config.Description: CUPS queue name of your real label printer. Cropped labels are forwarded here. No spaces (Label_Printer, not Label Printer). Add the printer in the web UI with exactly this name, or set Printer URI below.

Config.Name: Crop queue name
Config.Description: CUPS queue name of the crop queue (no spaces). Print A4/Letter shipping sheets to this queue.

Config.Name: Crop queue display name
Config.Description: Name shown on iPhone/Mac/Android print dialogs, e.g. Label Crop or Vinted Label.

Config.Name: Label width (inches)
Config.Description: Width of the output label in inches. 4 for 4x6. 100x150 mm labels: 3.937.

Config.Name: Label height (inches)
Config.Description: Height of the output label in inches. 6 for 4x6. 100x150 mm labels: 5.906.

Config.Name: Padding (points)
Config.Description: Extra margin kept around the detected label, in points (72 pt = 1 inch). Default 3.

Config.Name: Rotation
Config.Description: auto turns sideways labels upright. 0/90/180/270 force a fixed clockwise rotation (use if your labels come out upside down).

Config.Name: Default sheet size
Config.Description: Sheet size the crop queue advertises, so phones send the whole page. A4 for Vinted/InPost/Evri (UK/EU), Letter for US carriers.

Config.Name: Printer URI (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Creates the target printer automatically on first start if it does not exist, e.g. socket://192.168.1.50:9100 or ipp://192.168.1.50/ipp/print. Leave empty to add the printer in the web UI.

Config.Name: Printer driver (optional)
Config.Description: Optional, used with Printer URI. A PPD path (e.g. /config/drivers/ppd/MyPrinter.ppd) or a model name from 'lpinfo -m' (e.g. drv:///sample.drv/zebra.ppd). Empty with an ipp:// URI uses IPP Everywhere.

Config.Name: Target media (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Media/page size name to request from the target printer, e.g. w288h432. Empty picks a 4x6 size automatically.

Config.Name: Enable AirPrint (Avahi)
Config.Description: Advertise the printers over Bonjour/mDNS so iPhones and Macs find them. Needs host networking.

Config.Name: CUPS log level
Config.Description: CUPS error_log level. Use debug while troubleshooting.

Config.Name: USB printers
Config.Description: Pass USB through for USB label printers. Remove if your printer is network-only.
